name: Bridge hands to heels
instructions: Warm up your shoulders and back, then lie on your back with your feet flat near your hips and your hands by your ears, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press up into a full bridge with your arms as straight as you can make them.
Walk your hands toward your feet as far as you can while keeping your feet flat and hip-width apart.
Hold for 3 seconds, then have someone measure the straight-line distance along the floor from your wrist creases to the backs of your heels.
If you cannot press up off your head, skip the test and log 100.
